Answer: F
Reason: The CT images demonstrate a right pleural effusion and an anomalous vessel in the right lower lobe draining towards the inferior vena cava/right atrium region, which is characteristic of Scimitar syndrome (a congenital vascular anomaly). This finding corresponds to the "left second arc protrusion" (likely referring to the prominent right heart border/venous shadow often mistaken for or described in relation to cardiac contours in such anomalies) and right-sided findings without generalized cardiomegaly typical of heart failure.
